description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts CB Cameron Mitchell has cleared waivers and reverted to the team's IR list
items.impact: Mitchell was waived-injured earlier this week.
items.title: Cameron Mitchell clears waivers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears activated LB T.J. Edwards from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Edwards was sidelined to begin training camp. He has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: T.J. Edwards (ankle) activated from NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots activated TE CJ Dippre from the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Dippre opened training camp on the non-football injury list. He has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: CJ Dippre activated from NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jeremiah Wright left Wednesday's practice with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Wright was a fourth-round pick for New Orleans. He is competing for a depth role on the offensive line.
items.title: Jeremiah Wright suffers shoulder injury Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants placed DT Roy Robertson-Harris on injured reserve.
items.impact: Robertson-Harris opened training camp on the PUP list. He will likely spend the season on IR.
items.title: Roy Robertson-Harris placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants waived/injured WR Beaux Collins.
items.impact: Collins will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Beaux Collins waived by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed CB David Long Jr.
items.impact: Long will compete for a depth role in the Giants defensive back room.
items.title: David Long Jr. signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed CB DJ James.
items.impact: James spent the spring in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Giants secondary.
items.title: DJ James signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Gracen Halton was back at practice at 49ers training camp on Wednesday.
items.impact: Halton was dealing with a knee bone bruise.
items.title: Gracen Halton (knee) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers released DL Cameron Sample.
items.impact: Sample signed with San Francisco in April on a one-year contract. He will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Cameron Sample released by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers released DL Kevin Givens.
items.impact: Givens has been with the 49ers since entering the league as an undrafted free agent in 2019. He will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Kevin Givens released by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DL Ogbo Okoronkwo.
items.impact: Okoronkwo will compete for a depth role on the defensive line with the 49ers battling numerous injuries.
items.title: Ogbo Okoronkwo signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars signed OL Sam Mustipher.
items.impact: Mustipher will compete for a depth role on the Jaguars offensive line.
items.title: Sam Mustipher signs with Jaguars

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said LB Drue Tranquill has a lower back strain.
items.impact: Tranquill is hopeful to be fully healthy heading into the season as injuries have been hampering him.
items.title: Drue Tranquill dealing with back strain

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said CB Kristian Fulton has a hip flexor.
items.impact: Fulton will be eased back from his hip injury early in training camp.
items.title: Kristian Fulton has hip flexor

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said rookie LB Jeffrey Bassa has a groin strain.
items.impact: Bassa was a fifth-round pick of Kansas City this year. He is competing for a depth role in the Chiefs linebacker room.
items.title: Jeffrey Bassa dealing with groin strain

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed DL Parker Petersen.
items.impact: Peterson was waived last week. He will likely play in Thursday's Hall of Fame game.
items.title: Parker Petersen signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed OL Jake Curhan.
items.impact: Curhan gets an opportunity with Saahdiq Charles placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Jake Curhan signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: JuJu Smith-Schuster was back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster sat out Tuesday's practice. He is competing for a depth role in the Giants wide receiver room.
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster (knee) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Brian Burns did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is believed to be a minor injury for Burns. It is unclear what he is dealing with.
items.title: Brian Burns misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Malachi Fields went to a side field and worked with a trainer early in Wednesday's practice.
items.impact: Fields had a limited workload on Tuesday. The rookie remains day-to-day.
items.title: Malachi Fields works with trainer on side field Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants nickel Dru Phillips left practice with an apparent lower leg injury on Wednesday.
items.impact: Giants coach John Harbaugh said he thought it was "something small" and that Phillips will be fine. He is day-to-day going into Thursday.
items.title: Dru Phillips (leg) leaves practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: WR Ainias Smith passed through waivers unclaimed.
items.impact: Smith reverted back to the Panthers IR list.
items.title: Ainias Smith clears waivers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed WR Brandon Hayes.
items.impact: Hayes participated in the team's Rookie Camp on a tryout basis after not being selected in the 2026 NFL Draft. He will compete for a depth role in the Eagles wide receiver room.
items.title: Brandon Hayes signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets waived Keidron Smith.
items.impact: Smith will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Keidron Smith waived by Jets

title: Fantasy Player News
